title: node:crypto ECDSA
notes: Runtime-provided crypto binding. Each call wraps the raw SEC1 point in a fixed SPKI DER header, loads it with createPublicKey (node:crypto has no raw-key entry point) and calls crypto.verify('sha384', message, { key, dsaEncoding: 'ieee-p1363' }, signature). prepare (untimed) decodes the hex and encodes the message.
